title: A review delegation follow-up can't retarget a new source root: its workdir stays on the original root and the read-only policy refuses cd to the new one
outcome: A follow-up to a read-only review delegation can name a new review root, for example a sibling worktree holding a re-frozen candidate. The reviewer then works with that root as its workspace, under the same read-only policy, with no new write rights, or the follow-up is refused at once with a typed reason telling the caller to start a new review delegation. A Claude reviewer can verify HEAD, the index and the status of the root it is asked to review.
acceptance: A review delegation follow-up can't retarget a new source root: its workdir stays on the original root and the read-only policy refuses cd to the new one is done
